context: a single passage from a letter by J. D. Hooker, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: Are you coming up next week— we hope the Sulivans are coming to take a quiet pot-luck with us on Tuesday at 6 when Sinclair will be here & Lindley— Can you not come if to be in Town?
I cannot come up so soon as Tuesday, for we have relations in House: I doubt much whether I shall be up for Thursday
